head_commit.message:
fix(ci): repair macOS API checks and stalled rate retries

Review six DSL extension fingerprint changes from CI run 43140630559's
pinned Swift 6.4.1 artifact without relaxing isolation or semver checks.
Retain comparison reports and candidate snapshots when API admission fails.

Wake eligible parked requests when an authority retry elapsed before the
shared timer started. Preserve FIFO, capacity and fresh authority admission,
and reproduce the old lost wake with a deterministic clock regression.

Validation: 2,708 root tests, 146 load-tool tests, 423 Python helper tests,
strict HTTP DocC, documentation audit/navigation/examples, and actionlint.
The timer regression fails before the fix and passes afterward. Hosted
Swift 6.4.1 extension graphs exactly match the refreshed 86-symbol baseline.
